user_problem: A prose procedure hides conditional branches, making it difficult to follow consistently.
unique_output: A decision table with trigger, question, observable condition, branch action, rejoin point, and missing branch.
required_input: Complete SOP text, defined terms, role boundaries, and any stated default or exception rules.
critical_rule: Extract only documented branches; never invent a default action for an uncovered condition.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is runbook-scenario-table; this converts one procedure into decision logic rather than matching scenarios to runbook rules.
acceptance_scenario: Input says accept packages with intact seals; damaged seals go to supervisor; wet packages are unaddressed. Output creates intact and damaged branches and marks wet-package handling missing.
